name: @agents-js/example-a2ui-surface-smoke
description: Learning test for A2UI declarative surfaces. Drives the CreateSurface -> UpdateComponents -> UpdateDataModel lifecycle through @agents-js/a2ui-host (A2uiHost) + @agents-js/a2ui-renderer (renderSurface) into a happy-dom DOM, asserts the rendered surface contains real component nodes, then dispatches a user surface_event and proves it round-trips to the host's sendSurfaceEvent sink.
